title: What If Every Parrotfish Vanished? The Beaches Would Feel It

scenes.text: What if every parrotfish vanished? Many white sand beaches would stop being made.
A parrotfish scrapes coral and algae with fused teeth, grinds it up, and poops fine white sand.
One large adult can make over a ton of sand in a year.
Around one Maldives island, parrotfish made more than 85 percent of the reef sediment.
Scientists estimate up to 70 percent of the sand on some Caribbean and Hawaiian beaches came this way.
No parrotfish, no new sand. The supply that rebuilds these beaches would dry up.

description:
What if every parrotfish vanished?
One big fish can make over a ton of sand a year, and they supply most of the sand around some reef islands.
